title: Application of Commonwealth Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff M.D.P.U. 98, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quareterly Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of April, May, and June 1986. The Power Cost Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Applcation is also made by Commonwealth Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 106. The rules established in the filings to made by utilities with the Department, and set forth the fillings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
